notes.title: DRACAMAR arrives with its new DEMO at the Steam Next Fest
notes.content: [p]The new [b]DEMO[/b] of Dracamar will be available in the Summer [b]Steam Next Fest[/b], which will take place from June 9th to June 16th, and you can [b]play RIGHT NOW[/b]! Fight against King Crad, the evil dragon trying to conquer the world of Dracamar. Here are the changes included in this version, so don’t miss out on the chance of trying it:[/p][list][*][p]Improved control of the character so it doesn’t slow down while jumping.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements on mouse and keyboard, as well as more options to customize the camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements in the character’s movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements in some character animations.[/p][/*][*][p]New accessibility options, such as camera sensitivity settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Resource optimization to take up less space in the disk.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements on the memory usage of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements on the grounded enemies’ AI.[/p][/*][/list][p]Have fun now playing the demo with one of the 3 heroes that will be available in the final game, and experience a big and colourful adventure full of [b]platforms[/b], [b]puzzles[/b] and [b]magic[/b]. What’s more, you won’t be alone. Iko, a very special Oki, will accompany you on this mission and will show you that even the smallest ones can be great heroes.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Are you ready to become the last hope of Dracamar?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3557640/Dracamar_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you enjoy the demo, remember you can help us a lot by adding the game to your [b]wishlist, [/b]sharing the game with your friends and leaving a positive [b]review[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3306480/Dracamar/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Play the Demo Now! Dracamar - 3D Platformer Adventure
notes.content:
We are so excited to announce a brand-new adventure game we’ve been working on for the last year. Dracamar is a cute 3D platformer adventure set in a magical world of islands.

[previewyoutube=jbcWhIf0nsM;full][/previewyoutube]
Dracamar Demo includes:
[list]
[*] Beautifully rendered graphics.
[*] 1 Playable character.
[*] Play a complete level of the game for free, full of enemies, traps, and puzzles. 
[*] Discover all kinds of hidden medals, challenges, and collectibles.
[*] Designed to delight and challenge players of all ages and skill levels.
[/list]
[b]Play the demo now[/b] and make sure you review and wishlist Dracamar!
